claims: Giorgia Meloni is the current Prime Minister of Italy.
Giorgia Meloni assumed office on October 22, 2022.
Giorgia Meloni is the first woman to hold the position of Prime Minister of Italy.
Giorgia Meloni is the leader of the right-wing party Brothers of Italy (Fratelli d'Italia).
As of mid-April 2026, Giorgia Meloni has faced public criticism from U.S. President Donald Trump over her refusal to support the U.S.-Israel war on Iran.
Giorgia Meloni defended Pope Leo XIV against criticism from Donald Trump.
In April 2026, Giorgia Meloni announced that Italy would not renew its defense agreement with Israel.
Giorgia Meloni continues to advocate for security guarantees for Ukraine including a proposal modeled on NATO's Article 5.
Giorgia Meloni heads a right-wing coalition government.
Giorgia Meloni serves as the President of the Council of Ministers.
